deletion_audit.delete_command_scope: One exact absolute path after --; no wildcard.

other_sessions.verification_rule: Every preexisting path and inode must remain; newly created session files are allowed and left untouched.

preservation_policy.lossless_archive: Exact original JSONL bytes, including encrypted reasoning and original secret-shaped values, retained in a mode-0600 Git-ignored Zstandard archive.
preservation_policy.messages: Exact user and assistant text except secret-shaped values, which are replaced with type, length, and SHA-256.
preservation_policy.compactions: Exact compaction summary text except secret-shaped values; replacement history is counted and hashed.
preservation_policy.tool_calls: Exact tool names and arguments, including patches and commands, except secret-shaped values.
preservation_policy.tool_outputs: Exact through 8192 bytes except secret-shaped values; larger outputs retain SHA-256, size, first/last 2048 bytes, and up to 64 redacted diagnostic lines.
preservation_policy.reasoning: Encrypted reasoning bodies are not copied into the semantic archive; aggregate byte counts remain in the inventory and exact bytes remain in the lossless archive.
preservation_policy.event_manifest: Every source line retains raw size, SHA-256, timestamp, type, and subtype.

secret_scan.note: Potential values are never copied; only location, size, and SHA-256 are recorded.
